title: Expected distribution
view: Shared hand base (visuals/distribution_bases/hand): skeleton of the right hand from the palm side, then the right hand from the palm side (thumb on the image right) and from the back (thumb on the image left); right hand.
teachingPoint: An ulnar block in the forearm numbs the ulnar third of the hand, the little finger and the ulnar half of the ring finger.
claims: Skin: the ulnar third of the palm (palmar branches) and of the back of the hand (dorsal cutaneous branch, given off above the wrist), the little finger and the ulnar half of the ring finger on both sides.
Bone: the fifth metacarpal and the phalanges of the little finger (indication in the record: boxer's fractures). Not shaded: the radial two thirds.
Right hand; one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
